title: leucolinum tenuifolium
intro: Leucolinum tenuifolium, commonly known as Leucorhina tenuifolia, is a plant species in the family Apiaceae. It is a plant traditionally used in herbal medicine for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of this plant include its potential to support cognitive function, reduce inflammation, and improve cardiovascular health. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and neuroprotective properties.
